module.purpose: Defines the application-directory layout for wrapped pages, forwarding request nonce metadata and rendering configured head and body scripts through the shared page wrapper.
module.summary: This asynchronous layout reads the request's CSP nonce and two public environment-script settings, removes empty script entries, and injects the remaining scripts into the page wrapper. It preserves the incoming React content, disables license requirements for this route group, and applies the same nonce to every rendered script.
module.businessContext: Supports web-page composition, content security policy compliance, and runtime script injection. Failure can prevent wrapped pages or required integrations from rendering correctly.
functions: PageWrapperLayout (~L6-41): Renders page content and injects configured nonce-bearing head and body scripts.

io: Reads the current request headers to obtain the x-nonce value.

edgeCases.behavior: The nonce becomes undefined and is forwarded unchanged to the wrapper and rendered scripts.

edgeCases.behavior: The corresponding entry is removed before rendering, so no empty script is emitted.

edgeCases.behavior: The wrapper renders children without any injected script elements.
Children are rendered unchanged within the shared page wrapper.

invariants.description: The layout always renders children inside PageWrapper with requiresLicense set to false.
Every rendered injected script receives the request-derived nonce value.
Only script entries with truthy script content reach the rendering map.

assumptions.description: The layout is invoked by the Next.js App Router with a React.ReactNode children value.
The runtime provides process.env access for the two public script configuration keys.
The x-nonce request header contains the value expected by the application's CSP and script consumers.

concurrencyModel.notes: The function awaits request headers, then performs deterministic filtering and rendering without shared mutable state.
